name: planning
description: Structured implementation planning, interactive annotation review via Plannotator (with a local fallback), and plan execution with an adaptive review cascade sized to the plan.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a design into a task-by-task plan, review it, then execute it
interface.longDescription: Structured implementation planning (make) and autonomous plan execution (exec) for non-trivial, multi-file changes. Plan review defers to Plannotator when installed, falling back to a bundled annotation script otherwise. The review cascade during execution scales to plan size, and external adversarial review is always opt-in, never automatic. Supports project and user level custom rules, and ships a PreToolUse hook that prevents the skill from modifying its own files.
defaultPrompt: Use planning to write an implementation plan for this feature.
Review this implementation plan before I start building it.

external_review_cmd.title: External review command
external_review_cmd.description: Claude Code only. Command for external code review tool. The prompt is appended as the final argument; findings go to stdout tagged CRITICAL/MAJOR/MINOR. Leave empty to use codex. On Codex CLI/Copilot CLI, just tell the skill your preference in chat instead — there is no plugin-marketplace config prompt on those hosts.

task_retries.title: Task retries
task_retries.description: Claude Code only (see external_review_cmd note). Number of retries for failed tasks before stopping.

review_iterations.title: Review iterations
review_iterations.description: Claude Code only (see external_review_cmd note). Max fix-and-recheck cycles during internal review.

external_review_iterations.title: External review iterations
external_review_iterations.description: Claude Code only (see external_review_cmd note). Max iterations for external review adversarial loop, once the user has opted in. The loop exits early once an iteration finds no critical/major issues.

finalize_enabled.title: Enable finalize
finalize_enabled.description: Claude Code only (see external_review_cmd note). Whether to run the finalize phase (rebase and squash commits).

plans_dir.title: Plans directory
plans_dir.description: Claude Code only (see external_review_cmd note). Directory where plan files are located, relative to project root.

plan_size_threshold.title: Plan size threshold
plan_size_threshold.description: Claude Code only (see external_review_cmd note). Task count at or below which exec recommends the simplified (sequential, single-pass) review route instead of the full parallel review cascade.
